notes: Pinned to llama.cpp release b10355. The previous pin, b10344, did NOT register the muse-glimmer architecture -- bisection over the release tags put its first appearance at b10353 -- so the default model could never load and the extension produced no output. Do not move this pin below b10353. Official prebuilt release assets are repackaged rather than compiled; every asset is recorded with its SHA-256 and byte length, which the source-build flow never provided. Update only after model, security, and extension smoke tests. Windows archives are flat; macOS and Linux archives nest their payload under llama-<tag>/ and are the only ones carrying LICENSE.

win32-x64-cuda.notes: Roughly 1.1 GB unpacked, dominated by ggml-cuda.dll and cublasLt64_12.dll, so it cannot ship inside a VSIX. Fetched on demand and verified against these digests, the same way model weights are.
